output:
Office move: Station Road to Riverside House

We are moving to Riverside House, 14 Canal Street. Wednesday 2 December 2026 is the last working day at Station Road. The office closes at 16:00. Monday 7 December 2026 is the first working day at Riverside House.

What you need to do
- Pack your personal items in your two crates by 16:00 on Wednesday 2 December. The crates arrive on Monday 30 November.
- Label each crate with your name and team zone.
- Do not pack monitors, docking stations or keyboards. IT moves them.
- Take your laptop and charger home on 2 December.
- From Monday 30 November, book a desk in the DeskBook app, in your team's zone (A to D, floor 2).
- Collect your new badge at Riverside House reception from 08:00 on 7 December. Bring photo ID.

Questions? Email move-team@example.com.
